ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic metaphor of hidden pearls signify?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this metaphor is frequently applied to the Ahl al-Bayt, highlighting their innate purity (Ismah) and their concealment from the corrupting influences of the masses, much like a pearl protected within its shell. It underscores the concept of 'hiddenness' not as obscurity, but as a state of preserved sanctity that remains untainted by external impurities until revealed by divine will.
